results.content: RECENT TRENDS IN THE DATA-DRIVEN DIGITAL ECONOMY Data are a special resource different from goods and services CHAPTER I THE DIGITAL DIVIDE IN TERMS OF INTERNET CONNECTIVITY AND USE IS COMPOUNDED BY A DATA-RELATED DIVIDE For development purposes the distinction between raw data and data products (digital intelligence) is critical Two countries stand out as the frontrunners in harnessing the value of data: The largest digital platforms increasingly control all stages of the global data value chain The growth in data ﬂows has just begun Global Internet protocol traffic in 2022 will exceed all traffic up to 2016 International bandwidth use has accelerated during the last decade and is geographically concentrated along two main routes: 50% of the world’s hyperscale data centres highest rates of 5G adoption in the world 94% of all funding of AI start-ups 90% of the market capitalization of the world’s largest digital platforms the United States and China Collection Transmission Processing Use Storage During the pandemic their dominant positions have strengthened North America China Europe Regulating data ﬂows at the international level has become more urgent Cross-border data ﬂows are a new kind of international economic ﬂow, which lead to a new form of global interdependence Data play an increasingly important role as an economic and strategic resource, a trend reinforced by the COVID-19 pandemic as many activities moved online The data-driven digital economy is rapidly evolving amid huge divides in terms of digital readiness 23% of the population in LDCs have no access to a mobile broadband network Average Internet speed Developed economies LDCs Developed economies LDCs Use of Internet 90% 20% 8 X CHAPTER I 3 RECENT TRENDS IN THE DATA-DRIVEN DIGITAL ECONOMY A.
